notes.content: [h3]Update 1.0.1 notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed pressure plate disconnecting on level reload[/p][/*][*][p]Updated last level message to be more concise[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level 9-7 being trivial to solve[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed decomposer sometimes destroys a color during despawn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed decomposer block shows up again on undo[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pressure plate doesn't activate on undo if counter is at 0[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
